title: Depside and depsidone-rich hydroalcoholic extract, resourced from the lichen Parmelinella wallichiana (Taylor) Elix & Hale selectively restricts Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer by modulating p53, FOXO1 and PALLADIN genes.
authors: Saha, Saparja; Ray, Ribhu; Paul, Santanu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究地衣提取物通过调控p53、FOXO1等基因抑制肺癌，仅含小分子-蛋白受体对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The non-specificity of contemporary cancer therapeutics has enticed us to develop safer, anticancer alternatives from natural resources. Lichens are unique natural entities which have long been neglected for explorations in cancer therapy, despite their vast potential. Our present study aims to investigate the anti-cancer potential of a wild lichen Parmelinella wallichiana. The anti-proliferative efficacy of the lichen extracts were screened through MTT assay against a panel of cell lines and the potent hydroalcoholic extract was selected for further evaluation against the most sensitive lung-cancer cell line A549 by implementing a wide range of microscopic and flow cytometric applications. The observations suggest that the extract could selectively induce apoptosis by augmenting ROS and disrupting the mitochondrial membrane potentiality. It was also found that the lichen-induced apoptosis was regulated by two crucial tumor suppressor genes, FOXO1, and p53, along with cell cycle inhibitor p21 which ultimately resulted in robust apoptosis through the up-regulation of pro-apoptotic BAX expression. Moreover, the extract also restricted the cancer progression by down-regulating the PALLADIN expression. Further, an LC-MS-based metabolomic profile highlighted a number of depsides, depsidones and dibenzofurans, which included atranorin, physodalic acid, salazinic acid, constictic acid and usnic acid. Then, an in silico docking with these lichen-derived metabolites against the PI3Kalpha receptor predicted these compounds has a binding affinity close to a standard PI3Kalpha inhibitor copanlisib. The study concludes that the extract restricts lung cancer possibly through the PI3Kalpha/FOXO1 axis and thus Parmelinella wallichiana represents a potential resource for anti-lung cancer drug development in future.
abstract_zh: 当代癌症治疗的非特异性促使我们从自然资源中开发更安全、抗癌的替代方案。地衣是独特的自然实体，尽管其潜力巨大，但在癌症治疗探索中长期被忽视。本研究旨在探讨野生地衣Parmelinella wallichiana的抗癌潜力。通过MTT实验对一组细胞系筛选地衣提取物的抗增殖效果，并选择有效的氢醇提取物，针对最敏感的肺癌细胞系A549，采用多种显微镜和流式细胞术应用进行进一步评估。观察结果表明，该提取物能通过增强ROS和破坏线粒体膜电位选择性诱导凋亡。还发现，地衣诱导的凋亡受两个关键肿瘤抑制基因FOXO1和p53，以及细胞周期抑制剂p21的调控，最终通过上调促凋亡BAX表达导致强效凋亡。此外，该提取物还通过下调PALLADIN表达限制癌症进展。进一步，基于LC-MS的代谢组学分析揭示了多种缩酚酸、缩酚酮和二苯并呋喃，包括atranorin、physodalic acid、salazinic acid、constictic acid和usnic acid。随后，与这些地衣来源代谢物针对PI3Kalpha受体的计算机模拟对接预测，这些化合物具有接近标准PI3Kalpha抑制剂copanlisib的结合亲和力。研究得出结论，该提取物可能通过PI3Kalpha/FOXO1轴限制肺癌，因此Parmelinella wallichiana代表了未来抗肺癌药物开发的潜在资源。
